notes: The monitor setting is a display arrangement map again, not a dropdown. Your screens are drawn to scale in their real positions, numbered the way Windows numbers them, so choosing one is the same gesture as choosing one in Windows display…

NovaPanel now detects OLED displays and switches burn-in protection on for you the first time it finds one, then tells you which display it found. Windows exposes no panel-type field, so this reads the display name reported by the monitor…
OLED displays are marked on the arrangement map, so you can see which of your screens the protection applies to.
